title: Apron - Hard-Wearing, Multiple Colours
descriptionHtml:
A robust, practical apron designed for the BBQ master, the home cook and the creative type in the workshop alike. Made from hard-wearing material that stands up to heat, spills and wear. Perfect if you want functionality and a clean look in one.

The apron comes in several colours so you can pick the one that best suits your personal style. With adjustable shoulder straps and a comfortable cut, it sits well through the whole cook or work session.

The practical front pockets hold your tools, phone or other bits and pieces you want close at hand.

Features:

  • Made from hard-wearing fabric for long-lasting durability

  • Adjustable shoulder straps for the best fit

  • Several front pockets for tools and accessories

  • Available in several colours

  • Suits the BBQ, kitchen, bar, hobby projects and the workshop

Why choose this apron?

Unlike simpler models, this apron is built to last and to handle tougher use. It's good-looking, practical and versatile – a true all-round apron that works in all sorts of situations.

Perfect for anyone who wants an apron that looks the part and does the job, year after year.

title: BBQ Brush Ultra – Effective Cleaning for Your BBQ
descriptionHtml:
Keep your BBQ in top shape with our BBQ Brush Ultra.
Fitted with hard-wearing steel bristles and a handy scraper, it makes short work of burnt-on food and grease on the grates. Perfect if you want a clean BBQ fast, with no fuss.

The ergonomic handle gives you a solid grip even when the brush is used on hot surfaces, and the compact design makes it easy to store or take along.

Features:

  • Hard-wearing stainless steel bristles

  • Built-in scraper for burnt-on residue

  • Ergonomic handle for a comfortable grip

  • Effective cleaning for both charcoal and gas BBQs

  • Light and easy to use

With the BBQ Brush Ultra you get a reliable cleaning brush that makes barbecuing easier and more enjoyable – always ready for the next BBQ night!

title: BBQ Tongs – Multiple Sizes
descriptionHtml:
A good pair of BBQ tongs is a must for anyone who loves firing up the barbie!
With these handy BBQ tongs you can easily turn meat, veggies and sides on the BBQ with great control. The silicone tips give a secure grip and protect both your food and your BBQ grates.

Available in several sizes – pick the one that suits your barbecuing best, or combine a few for maximum flexibility.

Features:

  • Durable, hard-wearing BBQ tongs

  • Silicone tips for a secure grip that protects your grates

  • Ergonomic handle with non-slip grip

  • Easy to clean – dishwasher safe

  • Available in several sizes

Why choose BBQ tongs with silicone tips?

Unlike all-metal tongs, these are gentler on your food, give better grip and work perfectly even for delicate ingredients like fish and veggies.

An essential tool for everyday barbecues and big BBQ nights alike!

The ergonomic rubber handle makes it comfortable to use, while the non-slip rubber base adds extra stability and safety. Perfect for kitchen knives, scissors and any other blades you want to keep razor sharp.
